318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Morning Zoe. Let's start with the level three slab. Is your rebar finished?

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Zoe
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Almost. East side, two openings, trimmer bars not done. Drawing not clear.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Right, I'll raise an RFI with the designer and get you an answer before knock off. Mike, when's the pre pour inspection booked for?

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Mike
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Engineer's coming eight thirty tomorrow. If those trimmer bars aren't sorted we'll fail the hold point and lose the pour.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Hear that, Zoe? Eight thirty tomorrow. It has to be done today.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Zoe
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Not enough men. I have four guys only. Still need to tie column starter bars.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Park the columns. Slab is the priority. Mike, can we get two extra hands off the labour hire?

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Mike
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: I'll ring them now. Two from midday, but that's a variation, so I'll need it in writing.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: No worries, I'll send you a site instruction this arvo and cc the QS.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Zoe
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: One more thing. Scaffold, someone take away the handrail yesterday. Now that spot, no edge protection.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Sorry, what? That's a critical safety issue. Who took it out?

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Zoe
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Don't know. Maybe the facade subbie.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Mike
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Righto, I'll barricade it and tag it out before anyone gets near that edge. Ben, that one goes in the H and S report.

318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.speaker: Ben
318601b22d36478d968b8c2a3b72b5c0.line: Noted, I'll raise it at the toolbox talk this morning. Alright, that's us. Zoe, go sort those trimmer bars. Same spot, eight thirty tomorrow.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Leo, what's happening with the panels? Truck was meant to be here first thing.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Leo
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Yeah, it's running late. Couple of hours, maybe more. It's the north elevation ones on that load.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Joe, is that still alright for you? We've only got the crane till the end of the week.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Joe
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Bit marginal, mate. It's picking up out there. If it keeps going the way it is, we'll have to have a think about it.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Okay, well, just sing out if it gets to that point.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Leo
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: I had a look at the ferrules yesterday, most of them are fine. One of the panels isn't quite right though. There's a hole in it that's not where the drawing says.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: How far out are we talking?

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Leo
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Enough that it's going to be in the way of the ducting. I've mentioned it to the designer but haven't heard back.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Right. Well, don't hold up the lift for it, we can deal with the hole afterwards. Just make sure it doesn't get forgotten about, eh. Put it somewhere.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: And I'll have another crack at the designer.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Joe
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Oh, while you're here. Yesterday when we were lifting, a couple of the blockwork fellas came through where they shouldn't have been. Right underneath.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Joe
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Yeah. My dogman pulled them up but it was close. Cones aren't doing the job. I'd want something a bit more solid today, and someone standing there watching it.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Fair enough. Leo, can you get that sorted before we start? And have a word with their guys.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Leo
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Yep, I'll do it at the pre lift.

b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.speaker: Ben
b49627d7a6a4400783d796eae6f5f600.line: Good. I'll do something about yesterday too, and I'll bring it up this morning when everyone's together. We'll have another look at it once the truck turns up.
